summary: Core IAM→PR/merge→deliver→webhook path via ccctl/cc-api is real and coupled (branch_protection, ref_lease, webhook_crypto are load-bearing on the fixed merge/outbox path; policy files are no longer byte-clones). It still fails large_system_strict Q6: honest substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is ~2,290 (~1,937 Python from entrypoint import-closure + ~354 ops/policies/schema), below the >=3,000 floor. Complexity substantive_loc=3440 is not sufficient—it counts seed.py/seed.sql/catalog.json plus ~734 LOC of entrypoint-unreachable admin/report/facade modules. PADDING_RISK is HIGH.

evidence.observation: Q6 independently judges whether the solver-visible core is complex, reachable, coupled, non-toy, and non-padded. For large_system_strict, >=3,000 substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is necessary but not sufficient; Complexity Governor or authenticity-validator PASS is not enough.

Q6 method requires entrypoint tracing, reachability, distinct module responsibilities, clone/wrapper/padding checks, cross-module invariants, a ~25% removal test, and separating production logic from generated/config/data noise. PASS needs >=3,000 substantive reachable LOC and no HIGH toy/padding risk.

Count only implementation that materially participates in the claimed operational system. Dead/unreachable/unnecessary code and construction toward the 3,000-LOC floor via filler are authenticity defects. Seed volume is not authored runtime complexity.
Security/AppSec Python/bash CodeCommit control-plane task; artifacts [/app/codecommit]; separate verifier; workdir /app/codecommit; public network; agent timeout 7200.
Design authenticity report records profile=large_system_strict. Used only to bind the strict LOC/padding gate; not treated as a copied complexity verdict.
Primary operator entrypoint delegates to cc.cli.main with clone/push/pr/approve/merge/deliver/simulate/metrics/dispatch-webhooks.
API entrypoint imports cc.server.main; server re-exports cc.api.app.main which calls serve() then serve_forever—entrypoint is runtime-reachable (prior unbound-httpd defect remediated).
CLI wires authz_gateway, gitops, PR store/approvals/merge, deliver, policy_sim, metrics, webhook dispatch—no imports of ops_console/iam_report/admin facades.

HTTP Handler exposes health/repos/metrics/prs/push/approve/merge/deliver/webhooks/dispatch with deliberate broken non-fixed merge/push paths; serve() returns ThreadingHTTPServer and main() serves forever.

Fixed merge path couples IAM MERGE_FF authorize, approval quorum, prepare_protected_merge/finish_protected_merge (branch_protection+ref_lease), and gitops.update_ff—load-bearing cross-component coupling.
prepare_protected_merge consults branch_protection rules and acquires/releases ref leases; reachable from merge.merge on the fixed path.
Real rule matching and merge/push gate semantics against ops/branch-protection.json—not a constant shell.
Exclusive TTL leases with acquire/release/require_held/purge_expired persisted under var/ref-leases.json; coupled into merge_guard.
HMAC-SHA256 sign/verify/attach used from webhooks.outbox.attach_signature on the deliver→outbox path.

Docstring claims 'reachable control-plane helpers' and pulls approval_engine/batch_ops/config_schema/policy_admin/ref_guard/state_recovery, but neither ccctl nor cc-api imports this module—dead fan-in hub (~134 LOC).
ControlPlane facade duplicates CLI/API workflows but is never imported from entrypoints—wrapper padding (~55 LOC).
Compatibility shim aliases cc.api.app as routes_* for an architecture plan; unreached toy module.
Eleven policy JSON files have distinct content hashes (including four team-fragment-* files)—prior clone-policy inflation is remediated; policies are runtime config consumed by IAM eval when bound.

Independent inventory: complexity-style substantive_loc over environment=3440 (includes seed.py 230, seed.sql 55, catalog.json 106, and unreachable admin cluster). Non-blank non-# Python excl. seed.py=2671. Entrypoint import-closure from cc.cli/cc.server/cc.api.app reaches 48 modules / ~1937 Python LOC (incl. iam/eval, merge_guard, branch_protection, ref_lease, webhook_crypto, deliver/outbox). Unreached excl. seed: 13 modules / ~734 LOC (ops_console, iam_report, pipeline_admin, policy_admin, webhook_admin, batch_ops, integration_facade, state_recovery, repo_lifecycle, config_schema, approval_engine, ref_guard, api.auth). Runtime ops+policies+schema.sql non-blank LOC≈354. Honest substantive reachable runtime/config ≈1937+354≈2291—below large_system_strict >=3000 by ~700+.

Authoring counter reports substantive_loc=3440 with no duplicated_environment_files groups. Used only as a contrasting raw tally; Q6 does not copy that PASS or treat 3440 as reachable production depth.

findings.criterion: large_system_strict requires >=3000 substantive reachable solver-visible runtime/config LOC
findings.why_it_matters: The strict profile's scale floor is about reachable production logic, not raw environment line count. At ~2,290 honest reachable LOC the package remains under the gate even after counting consumed ops/policies/schema.
findings.minimal_remediation: Grow or deepen entrypoint-reachable runtime/config (wire load-bearing modules into ccctl/cc-api workflows, or add real coupled subsystems) until honest reachable substantive LOC clears 3000 without seed/catalog/unreachable filler.
findings.regression_risk: Naively importing ops_console from CLI without productizing those paths can create discard-touch theater and still fail Q6; adding only more seed/data JSON will not help.

findings.criterion: no HIGH padding risk from unreachable/admin/report/facade inflation toward the LOC floor
findings.why_it_matters: About 734 Python LOC (~25% of non-seed library code) is only reachable through an ops_console/admin cluster that entrypoints never call. Complexity's 3440 also folds seed and catalog into the tally. That is systemic padding relative to the claimed control plane, so PADDING_RISK is HIGH and blocks PASS.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either delete/shrink the dead admin/report/facade/auth-shim cluster, or make those modules load-bearing from ccctl/cc-api with distinct operator-visible behavior and state/error paths—not import-only touch wiring.
findings.regression_risk: Removing dead modules without adding real reachable depth will make the LOC miss more obvious; wiring with `_ = platform_report()` style discards would worsen authenticity.

change_scope: Entrypoint-reachable runtime modules under environment/codecommit/lib/cc (and any new subsystems they must own)
Optional deletion or productization of unreached admin/report/facade/shim modules
Runtime ops/policies/schema only if they accompany real coupled logic—not as LOC filler
do_not_change: Do not treat validate_task_complexity substantive_loc=3440 or any Complexity Governor PASS as Q6 clearance
Do not count seed.py, seed.sql, catalog.json, or authz warehouse row volume as substantive runtime/config LOC
Do not edit tests/ or solution/ to manufacture production depth evidence
Do not weaken branch_protection/ref_lease/webhook_crypto coupling on the fixed merge/outbox path while chasing LOC
next_gate: Producer must repair reachable depth/padding, then Orchestrator regenerates a fresh Q6 packet after the environment/task.toml scope changes (review_scope_hash will invalidate).

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing only IAM MFA/IP on API push while leaving merge_ff_broken and skipped MERGE_FF still fails the merge fence.
Enabling branch_protection rules without wiring prepare_protected_merge/lease acquire still allows unprotected merges.
Signing webhooks without attaching signatures on outbox enqueue still breaks verify on dispatch.
Importing ops_console from CLI without exposing real commands creates reachability theater.
Deleting unreachable modules alone without adding ~700+ LOC of load-bearing reachable depth still fails the floor.
Counting seed/catalog/complexity 3440 as clearance while leaving the dead admin cluster intact will fail the next independent Q6.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the load-bearing reachable core (iam/eval+conditions, authz_gateway, prs/merge+approvals, merge_guard/branch_protection/ref_lease, deliver/outbox/webhook_crypto, cli/api handlers) would collapse authorize→merge→deliver→dispatch behavior. Separately, removing the ~734 LOC unreached admin/report/facade/shim cluster would not change any ccctl/cc-api outcome today—strong evidence those lines are padding relative to the operator surface. Seed/catalog removal does not change runtime logic of an already-populated lab.
REQUIRED_CHANGES: Raise honest entrypoint-reachable substantive runtime/config LOC to >=3000 without seed/catalog/unreachable filler.

Eliminate HIGH padding: delete or productize the ops_console/iam_report/*_admin/batch_ops/integration_facade/state_recovery/config_schema/approval_engine/ref_guard/api.auth dead cluster with real ccctl/cc-api surface area.
Preserve (or deepen) existing cross-component coupling on IAM, protected merge/leases, and webhook crypto rather than replacing it with import-touch padding.
